description: Land Acquisition - Gangodawila, Sri Jayawardanepura-Kotte D/S Division, Colombo District
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about land acquisition notices under the Land Acquisition Act, detailing specific land parcels being acquired by the government for public purposes. It contains descriptions of properties, their locations, extents, and claimants, which falls squarely under the "Land and property-related matters" category for Type 4 (Land Gazettes).
